season: Game 1.4.002 (after the 2026-09-23 stage easing) · Dimensional Rift season 1 (to 2026-10-08)
lede: What Korean players push main stages and the Dimensional Rift with while under-powered: the power gate's brackets, the teams documented clearing at the 35% and 15% brackets, and what to swap per boss. Taken from DCInside, the official Naver cafe, KR YouTube and crumblehub's game data; every claim links to its post.
caveat: Snapshot of 2026-09-28, five days after the easing and the Rift's opening. Most shared stage decks predate the easing, so the post-easing deck rests on a handful of screenshot clears and top-player videos. No site ranks stage or Rift progress. 15% boss clears are claimed, never shown.
footer: Built from the research record's evidence captures.
formation_slots: A deck cookie's slot reads row<R>-<C> as in record 002: R is the row on the owner's formation screen (1 = top), C the column left to right. Only the all-in-one deck (dc:70308) posts its slots.

you.summary: With every cookie built, push at 35% with the Bari–Cherry Cola–Brightseeker charge deck and swap per boss slot; drop to 15% only on mob stages, and pad power across the next bracket line before fighting a boss a step lower. If your stage preset shows about 2.2G, the 55% bracket reaches 288-3, 35% reaches 304-19 and the 15% line covers every stage to 328-30 (computed from the game data; a stage preset rolled for power usually shows more than a conquest preset).
changes: Build a stage gear preset rolled purely for displayed power, with accuracy around 1,000, and a Skill Haste preset for auto; switch to the power preset when you sit just under a bracket line.
Keep SSR sugar-rune lines that add power (crit resist included) until you reach the Rift, then re-roll.
Keep Panda Dumpling ready as the third pet for launch bosses, and a GingerCraven swap (Scorpion, Jungle Warrior) for the -30 stages of the ruined city and snowfield.
Use stage-chapters.json to see where your power crosses 40% and 20% of recommended power: push on 35% to the 40% line, then only mob stages until the next line.
Reach 328-30 (4.00G for 35%) early: the Rift's 차원의 힘 grows only while you are in it, and early entrants compound.

stage.lede: Main stages (328 chapters of 30 stages, cycling through eight zones) and the Dimensional Rift (seasonal, boss-only, opened 2026-09-23 for players past 328-30).
stage.caveat: Pre-easing clears (before 2026-09-23) were made against higher recommended power for 169-1 to 328-30; stage-clears.json marks the era of each.

rules.title: Structure
rules.body: Chapters of 30 stages, labelled chapter-stage (243-30). The -10, -20 and -30 stages hold a chapter's bosses (or a boss pack of up to ten); the rest are mob stages. Stages run to 328-30 since 2026-09-10; clearing 328-30 opens the Dimensional Rift.

rules.title: Team and presets
rules.body: 12 cookies, 3 pets, a captain and mercenary band perks, as in the other modes. Gear presets switch between stage, arena and conquest sets; the stage fight uses the preset chosen on the formation (편성) screen, not the one picked in the gear menu.

rules.title: Idle rewards and boss retries
rules.body: The stage you park on sets the offline (idle) rewards. Boss stages are started by a boss summon; with auto-summon on, a deck retries a boss unattended.
